description:
The Deal Desk is a centralized, corporate Revenue Operations function responsible for governing non-standard, high-value commercial deals across PointClickCare. The team partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Executive Leadership to ensure pricing, billing, and contractual decisions balance customer flexibility with disciplined financial standards. This role operates as an individual contributor within the Deal Desk, supporting strategic deal reviews and serving as a trusted advisor on complex commercial structures. The Analyst plays a critical role in enabling deal velocity while maintaining consistency, transparency, and governance.  
 
The Deal Desk Analyst supports PointClickCare's Deal Desk by managing the intake, review, and tracking of concession and pricing exception requests. The role ensures every request is accurate, complete, and backed by clear analysis before it reaches approvers, and that decisions are documented and reported consistently. Working under the direction of the Manager, Deal Desk, the Analyst builds pricing workbooks and proposals, maintains Deal Desk data across systems, and produces monthly reporting on concession activity, providing data-driven insights that inform pricing, billing, and contract decisions. This position suits someone with strong Excel and analytical skills, high attention to detail, and an interest in growing into more complex deal structuring work. 
 

Key Responsibilities

Deal Desk Request Intake & Review

  • Serve as a point of contact for concession and pricing exception requests
  • Validate request details against internal systems and assess the risks and tradeoffs of each requested concession
  • Classify each request against the Deal Desk request taxonomy, confirm required approvals, and route to the appropriate approvers
  • Document decisions, approvals, and rationale so every request has a clear audit trail

Pricing & Deal Analysis

  • Build pricing models, billing ramps, and revenue forecasts using current pricing and packaging guidelines
  • Support financial and commercial analysis for non-standard and high-value deals, including the impact of discounts and term changes on MRR and overall deal economics
  • Convert internal pricing into clean, customer-facing proposals that meet PointClickCare standards

Deal Desk Data, Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain Deal Desk approval tracking so reporting stays accurate
  • Run regular data quality checks and resolve discrepancies across systems and teams
  • Support monthly Deal Desk reporting on request volume, concession types, approval outcomes, win/loss trends, and more

Sales Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Answer rep questions on pricing mechanics, approval requirements, and the Deal Desk intake process
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to confirm approved terms are set up correctly and accurately reflected in contracts and quotes
  • Partner with the Manager and fellow Deal Desk Analysts to share knowledge, align on request reviews, and apply standards consistently

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Help document Deal Desk processes, approval criteria, and the request taxonomy
  • Identify recurring request patterns and suggest improvements to pricing guidelines and Deal Desk policies
  • Build and maintain templates, tools, and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and improve turnaround time

Qualifications & Skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, analytics, or a related field
  • 1–3 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, pricing, finance, or a related analytical role
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, lookups, pivot tables) and the ability to build basic pricing and financial models
  • High attention to detail and comfort working with data across multiple systems
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize analysis for Sales and leadership audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce
  • Familiarity with SaaS pricing, discounting, quote-to-cash processes, billing models, and contract structures
  • Experience using AI tools or automation to streamline analysis and reporting
  • SaaS and/or healthcare industry experience
